role: exact dense clique-tree elimination for NATIVE PERFORMANCE CONTEXT (see QUALIFICATION.md); not a structural comparator unless qualified there

build.install_location: /Users/adis/Workspace/comparators/merlin (separate from the MDI tree; nothing of MDI is linked or imported by the binary)

adapter.role: thin input/output/supervision glue; no solver, kernel or certificate

command: merlin --input-file <model.uai> --evidence-file <model.uai.evid> --task MAR --algorithm cte --output-format uai --output-file <prefix>   (exact clique-tree elimination; fresh process; the model and evidence files are the pool bytes, unconverted)
threads: the binary is single-threaded (no std::thread / OpenMP use found in src/); the adapter still exports the six-thread environment the MDI cells use

numerics.partition_function: log-space m_logz = log(sum of root belief); PR line prints log Z and Z
numerics.marginals: normalized beliefs (belief / Z) printed std::fixed setprecision(6)
numerics.zero_evidence: STATUS 'false: Inconsistent evidence or underflow' when the root belief sum is 0.0 (no distinction between exact zero and underflow)
numerics.input_parsing: decimal tokens parsed as double; zero-arity factors multiplied into a global constant

guarantee: exact variable-elimination ALGORITHM executed in binary64 floating point; output = normalized marginals rounded to six decimals; NO error enclosure, NO independent check, NO certificate; agreement with references or conversion to rationals does not certify it
structural_mechanism: none beyond dense table elimination along a heuristic ordering: no determinism exploitation, no sparse/zero-skipping tables, no constraint propagation, no compilation of local structure (src/cte.cpp, include/factor.h inspected: dense std::vector<double> tables; zeros handled only as normalization guards)
